🌤️ 16°C mornings in Hyderabad this weekend? Natu kodi pulusu weather.
💬 Natu kodi: pulusu or fry? 👇

Save this Saturday recipe 👇
🛒 You need: 1 kg country chicken, medium pieces · 2 onions, sliced · 2 tomatoes · 2 green chillies · curry leaves · 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste · ½ tsp turmeric · 2 tsp red chilli powder · 1 tsp coriander powder · 1 tsp garam masala · tamarind, soaked · salt · 4 tbsp groundnut oil
1️⃣ Heat oil in the cooker; fry curry leaves, chillies and onions till golden.
2️⃣ Add ginger-garlic paste and tomatoes; cook soft.
3️⃣ Add the chicken, turmeric, chilli, coriander powder and salt; fry 8 minutes.
4️⃣ Add 1½ cups water, close and cook 5–6 whistles.
5️⃣ Add tamarind water and garam masala, simmer 10 minutes, finish with coriander.
